# TERRA STUDIO

> Handcrafted Scandinavian stoneware ceramics, sculptural vases, ambient lighting, and organic textiles.

## Collections
- [Complete Catalog](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/all): Complete catalog of ceramic dinnerware, lighting, and living objects
- [Stoneware Dining](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/stoneware-dining): Ceramic plates, bowls, mugs, and dining sets
- [Sculptural Vases](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/sculptural-vases): Ceramic vases and unglazed terracotta vessels
- [Ambient Lighting](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/ambient-lighting): Brass table lamps and frosted opal glass diffusers
- [Living Textiles](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/living-textiles): Pre-washed European flax linen throws and cushions
- [Curated Objects](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/collections/curated-objects): Travertine stone trays and stoneware candleholders

- [Speckled Ceramic Dinner Plate Set](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/products/speckled-ceramic-dinner-plate-set): Stoneware dinner plates, set of 4 ($145.00)

- [About the Studio](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/about): Craftsmanship, materials, and Scandinavian design philosophy

## Machine Interfaces
- [Agent Guidelines](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/AGENTS.md): Autonomous agent policies, crawl limits, and operational rules
- [MCP Discovery](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json): Model Context Protocol server definition and catalog tool schemas
- [A2A Agent Card](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent-to-Agent discovery card and catalog capabilities
- [Agents Intent Map](https://shariq-terra-studio-website.vercel.app/.well-known/agents.json): Intent-to-endpoint routing for shopping and research agents
